# Nominal pitch and batted-ball trajectory classification

A pitch or batted-ball motion is measured by a reusable nominal category ICE in a response-versioned Reference System; no provider coordinate is projected into a world-side Site.

This view shows the ontology pattern without MLB JSON paths or RML machinery.

flowchart LR
    N01["Nominal Measurement Information Content Entity"]
    N02["Referenced resource"]
    N03["Nominal Measurement Information Content Entity"]
    N04["Referenced resource"]

    N07["Baseball Event Record"]
    N08["Pitch Act"]
    N09["Batted-Ball Motion Process"]
    N01 -->|uses reference system| N02
    N03 -->|uses reference system| N04
    N07 -->|is about| N01
    N07 -->|is about| N03
